physicalNotes: Radius 0.866 +/- 0.006 solar radii from Krenn et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-421 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...686A.301K/abstract): 602,476 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.833 +/- 0.048 solar masses from Krenn et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-421 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...686A.301K/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5291 +/- 64 K from Krenn et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-421 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...686A.301K/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
